# API endpoints

<!-- Generated by scripts/api-reference.mjs from the controllers. Do not edit by hand:
     change the code (or the description in that script) and run `pnpm docs:api`. -->

122 endpoints (45 POST, 57 GET, 14 PATCH, 1 DELETE, 5 PUT); 21 public. How to call them — sign-in, errors, pagination, money — is in [README.md](README.md).

**Access** is the permission the caller's role must hold (`RESOURCE:ACTION`, see
[products-and-access](../architecture/products-and-access.md)); `INVOICING` means the company must subscribe to
Sugrpay and the user must hold a Sugrpay role. Routes under `/brands/:brandId` also require the brand to be one
the user can reach. **Request** names the schema the body (or query string) is validated against — in
`packages/invoicing-contracts/src/schemas.ts` or `packages/platform-contracts/src/schemas.ts`.

## Sign-in

| Method | Path                       | Access                      | Request                           | Response                                                            | What it does                                                                                                                                         |
| ------ | -------------------------- | --------------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| POST   | `/auth/forgot-password`    | public                      | body `forgotPasswordSchema`       | 202 `{ ok: true }`                                                  | Emails a password-reset link. Always answers the same way, so it does not reveal which emails exist.                                                 |
| POST   | `/auth/login`              | public                      | body `loginSchema`                | 200 `{ token: string; expiresAt: string; user: AuthenticatedUser }` | Signs in with email and password. Returns the session token (also set as a cookie) and its expiry. Locks the account after 5 failures in 15 minutes. |
| POST   | `/auth/logout`             | `ORGANISATION_PROFILE:READ` | —                                 | 204 no body                                                         | Ends the current session.                                                                                                                            |
| GET    | `/auth/me`                 | `ORGANISATION_PROFILE:READ` | —                                 | `CurrentUserResponse`                                               | The signed-in user: role, company, brands, products, product roles, locations and permissions.                                                       |
| POST   | `/auth/register`           | public                      | body `registerSchema`             | 202 `{ ok: true }`                                                  | Self-serve sign-up: creates the company, its owner (invited) and the Sugrpay subscription, and emails a set-password link.                           |
| POST   | `/auth/set-password`       | `ORGANISATION_PROFILE:READ` | body `setPasswordSchema`          | 200 `{ ok: true }`                                                  | Signed-in user replaces a temporary password.                                                                                                        |
| POST   | `/auth/set-password/token` | public                      | body `setPasswordWithTokenSchema` | 200 `{ token: string; expiresAt: string; user: AuthenticatedUser }` | Sets a password from an emailed link (sign-up, invitation or reset) and signs the user in.                                                           |

## Company and onboarding

| Method | Path                              | Access                      | Request                           | Response                                 | What it does                                                                                                 |
| ------ | --------------------------------- | --------------------------- | --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| GET    | `/company/subscriptions`          | `PLAN_AND_BILLING:READ`     | —                                 | `ProductSubscription[]`                  | The company's products and whether each is switched on.                                                      |
| PUT    | `/company/subscriptions/:product` | `PLAN_AND_BILLING:WRITE`    | body `updateSubscriptionSchema`   | `ProductSubscription`                    | Switches a product on or off for the company (no billing provider yet).                                      |
| POST   | `/merchant/brand-structure`       | `BRANDS:WRITE`              | body `brandStructureChoiceSchema` | `{ brand: CreatedBrandSummary \| null }` | Chooses single-brand or multi-brand.                                                                         |
| PATCH  | `/merchant/company-details`       | `BRANDS:WRITE`              | body `companyDetailsSchema`       | `{ ok: true }`                           | Saves the company details step of onboarding.                                                                |
| POST   | `/merchant/complete-onboarding`   | `BRANDS:WRITE`              | —                                 | `{ ok: true }`                           | Marks onboarding complete.                                                                                   |
| POST   | `/merchant/logo`                  | `BRANDS:WRITE`              | multipart upload                  | `{ logoUrl: string }`                    | Uploads the company logo (multipart field `file`, up to 5 MB).                                               |
| GET    | `/merchant/onboarding`            | `ORGANISATION_PROFILE:READ` | —                                 | `MerchantOnboardingState`                | Onboarding state: company details, brand structure, whether brands exist and whether onboarding is complete. |

| ------ | --------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/public/invoices/:token`                           | public | —                                                    | `PublicInvoiceView`      | The customer's view of an invoice by its payment-link token: amounts, lines, brand look, accepted methods. Records the first view. |
| POST   | `/public/invoices/:token/checks`                    | public | body `createCheckSubmissionSchema`, multipart upload | `{ id: string }`         | The customer uploads a check: number, amount, front and back images (multipart, up to 10 MB each).                                 |
| POST   | `/public/invoices/:token/payment-intents`           | public | body `createIntentBodySchema`                        | `PaymentAttemptResult`   | Starts a payment for the invoice (card, wallet or ACH) with the configured gateway.                                                |
| POST   | `/public/invoices/:token/payment-intents/reconcile` | public | body `paymentIntentReconcileSchema`                  | `PaymentAttemptResult`   | After the browser confirms a card payment, asks the gateway for the real outcome (fallback when the webhook has not arrived).      |
| GET    | `/public/invoices/:token/pdf`                       | public | —                                                    | no body                  | The invoice as a PDF.                                                                                                              |
| POST   | `/public/webhooks/fake-gateway`                     | public | —                                                    | 200 `{ received: true }` | Payment events from the built-in test gateway (signature verified; local testing only).                                            |
| GET    | `/storage/local`                                    | public | —                                                    | no body                  | Serves an uploaded file by signed, expiring link when files are stored on local disk (not used with S3).                           |

## Health

| Method | Path             | Access | Request | Response                                 | What it does                                                              |
| ------ | ---------------- | ------ | ------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/health`        | public | —       | no body                                  | Overall status, environment, active adapters and each dependency's state. |
| GET    | `/health/live`   | public | —       | `{ status: 'ok' }`                       | Liveness: the process is running.                                         |
| GET    | `/health/queues` | public | —       | `Record<string, Record<string, number>>` | Job queue sizes and states.                                               |
| GET    | `/health/ready`  | public | —       | no body                                  | Readiness: databases, Redis and storage reachable.                        |
